newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-JETS DEAL TOP CHOICE TO RAMS FOR FOUR PICKS IN DRAFT.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-JETS DEAL TOP CHOICE TO RAMS FOR FOUR PICKS IN DRAFT.

text.p: The New York Jets traded the overall first pick of this weekend's NFL Draft to the St Louis Rams for four picks on Thursday.
The Jets will receive the Rams' first-round choice, which is sixth overall, along with third, fourth and seventh round picks.
A deal was widely expected since Jets coach/director of football operations Bill Parcells was looking to accumulate extra selections to help stock a team coming off a 1-15 season.
